Name: Astravets nuclear power plant
compliance_point: control section (контрольный створ) downstream of the discharge
source: Belarus Ministry of Natural Resources Decree No.13 of 30.03.2015 'On water quality standards for surface water bodies', Annex 1 item 1.3
legal_ref: Постановление Минприроды РБ № 13 от 30.03.2015, прил. 1, п. 1.3 (column 'иных поверхностных водных объектов')
notes: SUMMER value, 'other water bodies' category (the decree's general case). Quote: 'не должна превышать естественную температуру ... более чем на 3 °С'; max '28 °С летом и 8 °С зимой'. The decree does not define summer/winter: the rows use calendar summer (Jun-Aug) and winter (Dec-Feb) and leave spring and autumn without a row. If the Viliya at Astravets is a salmonid/sturgeon water, the stricter column applies instead: rise <=1.5 °C, max 20 °C summer / 5 °C winter (class not confirmed). Decree may have been amended since 2015 (e.g. Decree 16/2017). Plant uses cooling towers with blowdown to the Viliya; plant EIA (belaes.by) not reachable.

Name: Doel nuclear power plant
averaging: Outfall: at most 33 °C instantaneous; at most 32 °C daily mean; at most 30 °C rolling 30-day mean
compliance_point: Discharge point (common outfall K3 and points K1/K2) into the Scheldt; no downstream compliance point
source: Environmental permit (milieuvergunning) decision of the Deputatie (provincial executive) of Oost-Vlaanderen, 31 Mar 2011, for Electrabel's Doel site (non-nuclear installations), 20 years
legal_ref: Besluit Deputatie Oost-Vlaanderen 31.03.2011 ref. M03/46003/46/2/A/5/HV/CW, Art. 2-3, condition 28 (lozen van koelwater); VLAREM II sectoral conditions for power-plant cooling water
notes: Quote: 'Maximum 32°C als daggemiddelde' (also 'Maximum 33°C als ogenblikkelijke waarde' and 30 °C rolling 30-day mean), stated as the VLAREM sectoral limits. Condition 28b: when the maximum discharge temperature is reached, or the intake water daily mean reaches 26 °C, thermal load must be reduced. This means maximum cooling-tower use and diverting the Doel 1/2 once-through water to the towers. No numeric dT or downstream limit in the permit. It cites the basic Scheldt quality norm ambiguously as '≤ 25°C + 3°C', so I did not report it. Confirmed by the Doel environmental statements 2022 and 2025 (https://omgeving.vlaanderen.be/sites/default/files/2025-07/DOEL-2025-Declaration-Environnementale-DEF-15.pdf). Observed trigger: 19 Jul 2022, Doel 1/2 run at half capacity as the 24-hour mean outfall approached 32 °C (Brussels Times). The 2022 statement lists a permit-change request on discharge temperature during heatwaves; outcome unknown. The permit runs about 20 years (to around Mar 2031); it may since have been converted to an omgevingsvergunning. Brackish estuary, about 7000 m3/s tidal flow.

Name: Tihange nuclear power plant
averaging: dT: daily mean (moyenne journalière). 28 °C: maximum after mixing; may be exceeded 2% of the time but never above 29 °C; median below 25 °C also required
compliance_point: Meuse after mixing at the Ampsin-Neuville dam (downstream of the plant)
source: Answer of Walloon Minister C. Di Antonio to parliamentary question by R. de Demeuse, 19 Jul 2019, describing the plant's environmental permit (permis d'environnement) of 9 May 2008 (20 years)
legal_ref: Walloon permis d'environnement of 09.05.2008 for CNT (non-nuclear aspects), thermal discharge conditions; protocol on Meuse temperature monitoring Huy-Liège (end 1997)
notes: Quotes: 'maximum 28 °C après mélange au barrage d'Ampsin Neuville'; 'en moyenne journalière ne peut dépasser 4 °C'. The minister says 4 °C is the strictest value in the 2008 permit, depending on flow and period. Special warming conditions exist for 07-01 to 03-31 and 04-01 to 06-30, but the values were not given. Operator environmental statements (seen only in search snippets; the Engie site returned 403) say 4 or 5 °C depending on time of year, and some editions say 5 °C. The 1997 Huy-Liège protocol imposed 5 °C. So the 4 °C is the strictest value, not necessarily all-year. The derogation column (29 °C) is the permit tolerance: the 28 °C limit may be exceeded at most 2% of the time, never reaching 29 °C. It is not a special heatwave derogation. Corroborated by an Engie spokesperson (RTBF 26 Aug 2020): 'sans jamais dépasser les 29 degrés'; no limit on Meuse flow. No outfall-temperature limit found. The permit expires around May 2028. No observed curtailment found.

Name: Kozloduy nuclear power plant
compliance_point: point of practically complete mixing of effluent with receiving water; if not determinable, 100 m from the outfall
source: Bulgarian Ordinance No.6 of 9.11.2000 on emission norms for wastewater discharged into water bodies (DV 97/2000, amended DV 24/2004), Annex 5, sector 2.1 'Термични електроцентрали'
legal_ref: Наредба № 6/2000, Приложение № 5, т. 2.1 + footnote *
notes: Quote: 'повишаване температурата на водоприемника < или = 3 °С'. Applies to thermal power plants; applying it to an NPP is an inference. FAOLEX text runs only to 2004; later amendments not checked. No absolute river maximum found. The Kozloduy new-unit EIA (DICON-Acciona 2013, Ch.4.9.4.2 p.75-76, https://www.umwelt.steiermark.at/cms/dokumente/11940599_9175955/c06bb812/EIAR_Chapter_4_4_7_to_4_15_EN.pdf) states a 'permissible limit for the temperature rise' of 3 °C for the warmest month and 5 °C for the coldest month, without naming the legal source or the months; compliance checked as daily means Oryahovo (km 678) vs Lom (km 743.3), where the difference averages 1.5-2.0 °C and 'in certain cases exceeds 3.0 C'. Hot-channel discharge permit No.13120037/22.11.2010 has no temperature limit. Observed curtailment: Unit 5 cut about 120 MW from 21 Aug 2026 because of low Danube level, not temperature.

Name: Dukovany nuclear power plant
averaging: weekly measurements above the discharge and at the end of the mixing zone; compliance requires all samples to meet the value; sudden exceedances must be avoided
compliance_point: end of the mixing zone (where temperatures at both banks equalise), in designated salmonid water no. 288 'Jihlava pod Mohelnem' (Jihlava from the Mohelno dam to the Oslava confluence)
source: Czech Government Regulation 71/2003 Sb. on fish waters, Annex 2 (temperature); designation of water no. 288 in Annex 1
legal_ref: NV 71/2003 Sb. Annex 2 item 1 (salmonid: max 21.5 °C, dT 1.5 °C); also NV 401/2015 Sb. Annex 3 Table 1a (29 °C)
notes: Quote: "Vypouštění způsobující oteplení nesmí způsobit ... zvýšení teploty na hodnoty vyšší než: 21,5 °C". A reduced 10 °C limit applies only during spawning of cold-water species (trout, grayling, burbot, sculpin) where they occur. Downstream cyprinid water no. 299 'Jihlava dolní' (below the Oslava confluence): 28 °C, dT 3 °C. The Dukovany II EIA (https://portal.cenia.cz/eiasea/download/RUlBX01aUDQ2OV9kb2t1bWVudGFjZURPQ184MjQzNjcwMzc0Mzc3MjY0MzA4LnBkZg/MZP469_dokumentace.pdf, PDF p.387) confirms the designation and applies the 21.5/28 °C limits; it compares the Jihlava–Mohelno pod profile against the NV 401/2015 'Maximum: 29 °C' (p.384). Plant permit: Kraj Vysočina decision KUJI 50087/2007 (26.7.2007), amended by KUJI 67546/2011. Per the EIA annex (https://portal.cenia.cz/eiasea/download/RUlBX01aUDQ2OV9wcmlsb2hhRG9rdW1lbnRhY2VET0NfNTg1MzE1NTQ3NzA5OTg3NzQ4NS5wZGY/MZP469_prilohaDokumentaceDOC_4.pdf, p.56) its binding indicators are pH, NL, RAS, C10-C40, sulfate, Ca, N-NH4, CODCr; no temperature limit is listed. The Czech Environment Ministry (MZP/2021/130/994) says a temperature limit, if any, would be in the regional discharge permit. Blowdown goes to the Mohelno reservoir (via Skryjský potok), which is not a designated fish water.

Name: Temelin nuclear power plant
compliance_point: wastewater outfall at Kořensko (Vltava), before discharge via the Kořensko II small hydro plant
source: EIA documentation 'Nový jaderný zdroj v lokalitě Temelín' (ČEZ, 2010), section B.III, document page 185 of NJZ_ETE_final.pdf in the CENIA archive MZP230
legal_ref: Water-law decision č.j. Vod 6804/93/Si (15.9.1993) as amended by OkÚ České Budějovice č.j. 10424/93/01-231/2-Si (8.3.2002) and KÚ Jihočeský kraj č.j. KUJCK 10012/2004 OZZL Ža (2004); further amended by KUJCK 18378/20/2005 (22.1.2007)
notes: Quote: "Pro stávající provoz jsou povoleny následující limity: ... teplota: 32,3 °C". Permit age: 2010 EIA citing the permit as amended to 2007, so current status is unverified. The EIA states the observed maximum Vltava warming by Temelín was 0.4 °C (13 Dec 2003); summer effluent is about 21-27 °C. The EIA also cites the old NV 61/2003 annual-mean/c90 immission standard of 14 °C.

Name: Temelin nuclear power plant
averaging: weekly measurements above the discharge and at the end of the mixing zone; all samples must comply
compliance_point: end of the mixing zone downstream of the Kořensko outfall
source: Czech Government Regulation 71/2003 Sb. on fish waters, Annex 2; Annex 1 cyprinid water no. 62
legal_ref: NV 71/2003 Sb. Annex 2 item 1 (cyprinid: max 28 °C, dT 3 °C); also NV 401/2015 Sb. Annex 3 Table 1a (29 °C)
notes: Quote: "zvýšení teploty na hodnoty vyšší než: ... 28 °C" (cyprinid). I infer the stretch below the Kořensko weir is inside it but did not find this confirmed for the outfall. Fallback: NV 401/2015 Annex 3 Tab. 1a surface-water temperature 29 °C (https://www.zakonyprolidi.cz/cs/2015-401). A 10 °C spawning-period limit applies only where cold-water species occur.

No downstream or outfall temperature limit; the decision exempts EDF from the discharge-temperature limit of art. 31, arrêté 2 Feb 1998. No exceptional-climate clause. Matches EDF open data.

Name: Bugey nuclear power plant
compliance_point: Rhône downstream of discharge, after mixing (calculated per [EDF-BUG-114] of 2014-DC-0442)
source: ASN decision 2014-DC-0443 (text as homologated, AIDA/INERIS); confirmed by ASN technical note on summer 2022
legal_ref: Décision ASN n° 2014-DC-0443 du 15/07/2014 (modifiée), annexe prescription [EDF-BUG-161]
notes: Quote: '24 °C pour la température moyenne journalière du Rhône calculée en aval après mélange'. Limits apply to the whole site (units 2-3 once-through, units 4-5 cooling towers). Exceptional level, only if RTE requires minimum output: 27 °C downstream daily mean; dT 1 °C when downstream is between 26 and 27 °C, with reactors 2 and 3 shut down. No outfall-temperature limit: decision exempts EDF from arrêté 2/2/1998 art. 31. Temporary heatwave decisions: 2022-DC-0729/0730 dT<=3 °C daily (15 Jul-7 Aug 2022); 2022-DC-0739 dT 5 °C and T 28.5 °C if Rhône flow <300 m3/s, else dT 3 °C (8 Aug-11 Sep 2022); 2026-DC-052 dT<=1 °C daily mean for units 4-5 until 20 Jul 2026 (ASNR expected downstream to stay <=28 °C). Observed curtailment trigger: unit 3 shut 25 Jun 2026 ahead of Rhône reaching 26 °C (AFP).

Name: Cattenom nuclear power plant
compliance_point: Moselle after mixing; EM = Qseo(Tseo-Tmp)/(Qref-Qsem+Qseo) ([EDF-CAT-98] of 2014-DC-0415); T_outfall at outfall C1
source: ASN décision n° 2014-DC-0416 du 16 janvier 2014 (version consolidée au 17 mars 2026)
legal_ref: [EDF-CAT-146]
notes: Values apply when upstream Moselle T <= 28 °C: dT 1.5 °C and discharged effluent <= 28 °C (daily mean, outfall C1). If 28 < T_upstream <= 30 °C: dT = 0 °C. If T_upstream > 30 °C: no discharge allowed (rain and sewage water excepted). No downstream-temperature limit. Exceptional (II): only if RTE requires minimum output or for supply/demand balance, limit = 0 °C dT, even above 30 °C upstream. So the plant must reach zero net warming rather than having a higher ceiling. Quote: "1,5°C pour l'échauffement moyen journalier après mélange". Unchanged by 2026-DC-038. Matches EDF open data.

Name: Chinon nuclear power plant
compliance_point: Loire after mixing; dT = q_rejet*(T_rejet-T_Loire)/Q_Loire ([EDF-CHI-129] of 2015-DC-0528)
source: ASN décision n° 2015-DC-0527 du 20 octobre 2015 (version consolidée au 26 juillet 2022)
legal_ref: [EDF-CHI-180]
notes: Quote: "échauffement moyen journalier ... de la Loire supérieur à 1°C après mélange". Conditional: Q_Loire < 100 m3/s AND T_upstream < 15 °C -> dT >1 but <1.5 °C. Exempt from the discharge and downstream temperature limits of art. 31, arrêté 1998. Limit is on the Loire (the plant discharges to the Loire). Matches EDF open data (CHINON B).

Name: Chooz nuclear power plant
compliance_point: Meuse downstream after mixing
source: ASN décision n° 2009-DC-0165 du 17 novembre 2009
legal_ref: Article 7 (Rejets thermiques)
notes: Normal limits 28 °C / dT 3 °C. Exceptional: if natural Meuse temperature at the intake > 26 °C (daily mean), for at most 5 days/year May-September inclusive, limits become 30 °C downstream and dT 2 °C (note: dT tightens to 2). Quote: "dans la limite de 5 jours par an de mai à septembre inclus". Franco-Belgian agreement of 8 Sep 1998 (décret 98-1004) is cited in the decision but sets no temperature limit; it drives flow rules (2009-DC-0164 art. 4: evaporation capped at 2.1 m3/s, 5% of flow when 12-day mean downstream flow is 20-22 m3/s, zero below 20 m3/s or when daily flow <= 14 m3/s). Observed curtailment: unit 2 stopped 11 Jul 2026 and unit 1 on 1 Aug 2026 to respect the 1998 agreement on Meuse flow (21.3 m3/s on 11 Jul), not temperature (EDF Chooz notice).

Name: Chooz nuclear power plant
compliance_point: Meuse downstream after mixing; dT between upstream (SM1) and downstream; dT = q_rejet*(T_rejet-T_amont)/Q_Meuse_aval (2009-DC-0164 art. on monitoring, VII)
source: ASN décision n° 2009-DC-0165 du 17 novembre 2009
legal_ref: Article 7 (Rejets thermiques)
notes: Normal climatic conditions, all year: quote "28°C pour la température moyenne journalière de la Meuse en aval après mélange" and 3 °C daily-mean dT. This row is the Oct-Apr part of the all-year rule; the May-Sep row adds the exceptional regime.

Name: Civaux nuclear power plant
compliance_point: Vienne downstream of discharge (stations SM1/SM2), conditions set by upstream Vienne temperature
source: ASN decision 2009-DC-0139 consolidated text (ASNR); amendment 2025-DC-028 changes art. 7 only to rename ASN to ASNR; ASNR inspection letter CODEP-BDX-2026-038810 for 30 °C outfall
legal_ref: Décision ASN n° 2009-DC-0139 du 02/06/2009 modifiée (2011-DC-0233; 2025-DC-028 du 16/12/2025), annexe art. 7
notes: Conditional table (art. 7, hourly means): upstream <25 °C gives T aval <=25 °C and dT <=2 °C. Upstream >=25 °C with purge cooler CVP available gives T aval <= T upstream, dT <=0 °C. Upstream >=25 °C with CVP fortuitously unavailable (only if RTE needs output; >3 days needs ASNR approval) gives T aval <=28 °C and dT <=1 °C (this is the derogation value). Winter: severe low flow Nov-Apr, dT may go above 2 °C up to 3 °C with ASNR DG approval. Outfall limit: see the national_rule row. 2025-DC-028: https://reglementation-controle.asnr.fr/content/download/208188/file/2025-DC-028.pdf. In 2026, CVP failures (25 May, 27 May, 14-19 Jun) caused unauthorised warming and outfall >30 °C on 14 Jun.

Name: Civaux nuclear power plant
compliance_point: discharged effluent
source: ASNR inspection letter INSSN-BDX-2026-0048 quoting arrêté du 2 février 1998 art. 31 (applied to Civaux via arrêté du 7 février 2012 art. 4.1.3)
legal_ref: Arrêté du 02/02/1998, art. 31; arrêté du 07/02/2012, art. 4.1.3
notes: Quote: 'inférieure à 30 °C sauf si la température en amont dépasse 30 °C'. In 2026, failures of the CVP purge cooler (25 May, 27 May, 14-19 Jun) caused unauthorised warming and outfall >30 °C on 14 Jun (ASNR inspection letter CODEP-BDX-2026-038810).

Name: Cruas nuclear power plant
averaging: daily mean (mean of hourly-step instantaneous values)
compliance_point: Rhône downstream, after mixing, calculated by formula in [EDF-CRU-253] of 2016-DC-0549
source: ASN decision 2016-DC-0548 (ASNR PDF); calculation method in 2016-DC-0549 consolidated at 24 Feb 2026

No temporary heatwave decision found for Cruas.

Name: Dampierre nuclear power plant
compliance_point: Loire, theoretical perfect mixing
source: ASN décision n° 2022-DC-0732 du 21 juillet 2022 modifiant la décision n° 2011-DC-0210
legal_ref: [EDF-DAM-70] (formerly [EDF-DAM-137] of 2011-DC-0210)
notes: Quote: "échauffement moyen journalier de la Loire supérieur à 1°C". Conditional: Q_Loire < 100 m3/s AND T_upstream < 15 °C -> dT >1 but <1.5 °C. Para II: replaces the downstream-temperature and discharge-temperature limits of art. 31, arrêté 1998, so neither applies. The recitals say no downstream/outfall limit is needed. Name: Golfech nuclear power plant
averaging: daily mean for downstream T; dT averaging not confirmed (possibly hourly, see notes)
compliance_point: Garonne downstream of discharge, after mixing
source: ASN technical note 'Rejets thermiques ... retour d'expérience de l'été 2022' (table of permanent limits); ASN inspection letter CODEP-BDX-2021-041467
legal_ref: Arrêté du 18/09/2006 autorisant EDF à poursuivre les prélèvements d'eau et les rejets ... site nucléaire de Golfech, art. 22 (JORFTEXT000000788608)
notes: ASN note table: 'Du 1er juin au 30 septembre ΔT (échauffement) : 1,25°C ... T° max aval : 28°C'. Exceptional level (RTE): dT 1.25 °C and 30 °C downstream. Inspection letter (https://reglementation-controle.asnr.fr/content/download/179921/2013273): 'température aval ... inférieure à 28°C en moyenne journalière'. Temporary 2022 decisions (2022-DC-0728, 0730, 0739): dT<=0.3 °C 'en valeur moyenne horaire' 'calculée dans les conditions définies à ce même article', which suggests art. 22 uses hourly dT (unconfirmed). Outfall limit unknown. Observed curtailment trigger: unit shut 9 Jul 2026 as Garonne expected to reach 28 °C (AFP).

averaging: daily mean for downstream T; dT averaging not confirmed

Name: Nogent nuclear power plant
compliance_point: Seine, between upstream and downstream of site (point de rejet aval)
source: EDF press notice 23-30 June 2026; EDF Rapport annuel d'information du public Nogent 2021 (§5.2.2), both citing Arrêté du 29 décembre 2004
legal_ref: Arrêté interministériel du 29 décembre 2004 (NOR INDI0404365A)

Exceptional conditions: 30 °C mean Seine temperature instead of 28 °C, if grid security requires (in arrêté since 2004). Annual report 2021: arrêté sets 3 °C, calculated daily. EDF open data (https://opendata.edf.fr/explore/dataset/seuils-et-limites-des-rejets-thermiques-aux-abords-des-centrales-nucleaires-d-edf-sa) gives T_aval < 28 and dT < 3; exceptional T_aval < 30 and dT < 1.5 (the 1.5 is only in open data). Observed curtailment: unit 2 output cut from 23 Jun 2026, unit 1 stopped 25 Jun 2026 (Seine temperature); RTE required unit 2 to stay online, so the 30 °C limit applied.

Temporary 2022-DC-0739 (8 Aug-11 Sep 2022): canal flow <480 m3/s gives dT 4 °C and T 30 °C; >480 m3/s gives dT 3 °C (used 9 days).

Name: Paks nuclear power plant
averaging: instantaneous at any point of the cross-section; operator states compliance is judged on the 95% value of the empirical distribution of boat-transect measurements (0.5 m and 1.5 m depth, 1 s sampling, 11:00-14:00)
compliance_point: any point of the river cross-section 500 m downstream of the discharge point (discharge Danube rkm 1526.0, reference section rkm 1525.5)
source: Hungarian decree 15/2001 (VI.6.) KöM, consolidated text in force from 2024-08-16
legal_ref: 15/2001 (VI.6.) KöM rendelet §10(1)a-b and §10/A(1) (inserted by 12/2024 (VIII.15.) EM rendelet); measurement rules in Baranya County Government Office decision 391-18/2017
notes: Quote §10(1)b: "a befogadó víz hőmérséklete nem haladhatja meg a 30 °C-ot". §10(1)a: discharged minus receiving water temperature must be <=11 °C (<=14 °C when receiving water is below +4 °C). That is an outfall-vs-river difference, not mixed river warming, so dT_max_C is left blank. §10/A(1): the 30 °C limit may be exceeded for security of supply with consent of the minister responsible for energy policy (no cap or duration in the decree). The 31.5 °C derogation ceiling comes from the operator page https://atomeromu.mvm.hu/hu-HU/Rolunk/Vizhomerseklet (secondary): "az eseti eltérések ideje alatt sem haladhatja meg a 31,5 °C-ot"; that page says load must be cut if the plume exceeds 31.5 °C regardless of ministerial consent. Daily measurements start once the Danube reaches 25 °C at 11:00. Note: the plume at 500 m is not fully mixed.

Name: Cernavodă nuclear power plant
compliance_point: after crossing the mixing area (Danube); separate rule for Danube-Black Sea Canal Race II
source: Environmental Agreement for Cernavodă NPP Units 3&4 (Annex to Gov. Decision 737/2013), Espoo copy published by Land Steiermark
legal_ref: Water Management Endorsement No.54/2013 (Romanian Waters), renewing No.35/2011; restated in Environmental Agreement p.18 and p.54-55
notes: Quote: 'maximum 10 C above the Danube water temperature, but no higher than 35 C, after crossing the mixing area'. Same wording on p.18 and in the footnote to the process-water discharge table on p.54-55. Ambiguous whether the 10 °C applies to the effluent itself or to the river after mixing. Discharge into Race II of the Danube-Black Sea Canal: max 10 °C above Race I and no more than 25 °C downstream of the discharge point; used only in special situations with approval. Observed curtailments: Unit 1 shut 27/28 Jul 2026 and Unit 2 in mid-Aug 2026, driven by low Danube level/flow (about 1500-1650 m3/s), not by a temperature limit (WNN, Euronews).

Name: Cernavodă nuclear power plant
compliance_point: receiving water (natural receptor) after receiving the effluent
source: HG 188/2002 as amended by HG 352/2005, Annex 3 NTPA-001/2002, Table 1 (consolidated to 19.03.2007)
legal_ref: HG 188/2002 Annex 3 NTPA-001/2002 Table 1 row 1 'Temperatura' + footnote *1
notes: Effluent limit: 'Temperatura*1) °C 35'. Footnote: 'temperatura receptorului natural nu va depăşi 35°C'. The consolidated text runs only to March 2007; later amendments not checked.

Name: Bohunice nuclear power plant
compliance_point: below the mixing zone of the Drahovce–Madunice derivation canal of the Váh (receiving water for the Socoman wastewater collector)
source: EIA report 'Nový jadrový zdroj v lokalite Jaslovské Bohunice' (JESS, 08/2015), page 287/458
legal_ref: Okresný úrad Trnava decision OU-TT-OSŽP2-2013/00026/Gl (18.10.2013)
notes: Quote: "limitná hodnota pre teplotu vody pod zmiešavacou zónou ... stanovená na 28 °C". Caveat: the EIA attributes this decision to JAVYS (decommissioning operator), which shares the Socoman collector. SE's V2 has its own discharge permit KÚŽP-1/2006/00271/Fr (14.07.2006); I found no temperature value for it. The EIA modelled V2/new-unit effluent at 33-36 °C into a canal at minimum guaranteed flow 6.40 m3/s. National rule: NV 269/2010 Annex 1 Part A surface-water temperature <26 °C as P90 (https://static.slov-lex.sk/pdf/prilohy/SK/ZZ/2010/269/20221115_3739598-2.pdf).

Name: Mochovce nuclear power plant
averaging: not stated (limit table of the permit; analyses 48x per year)
compliance_point: wastewater outfall to the Hron at rkm 75.4, below the Kozmálovce weir
source: EIA report 'Atómová elektráreň Mochovce VVER 4x440 MW, 3. stavba' (July 2009), Tab. 18, page 156
notes: Quote (Tab. 18, permitted limit concentration): "Tmax [°C] 30". The 2008 mean effluent was 18.7 °C. The permit is old (another passage of the EIA says the Hron discharge permit ran to end-2010); the current permit for units 1-4 was not found. The same EIA states that the then NV 296/2005 (since repealed) capped non-trout rivers at 26 °C and river warming at 5 °C; that was not verified in the old law text.

Name: Mochovce nuclear power plant
compliance_point: surface water (general quality requirement; no specific compliance point)
source: Slovak Government Regulation 269/2010 Z.z. (consolidated 15.11.2022), Annex 1 Part A item 7
legal_ref: NV 269/2010 Z.z. Annex 1 Part A item 7; Annex 2 (fish waters) gives 21.5 °C / dT 1.5 °C (salmonid) and 28 °C / dT 3 °C (cyprinid) at the edge of the mixing zone, compliance P98
notes: Quote (Annex 1 Part A): "Teplota t ºC <26", with P90 evaluation. Fish-water values from Annex 2 (https://static.slov-lex.sk/pdf/prilohy/SK/ZZ/2010/269/20221115_3739602-2.pdf): "Vypúšťanie oteplených vôd nesmie spôsobiť prekročenie teploty ... 28 oC" (cyprinid). I did not find whether the Hron at Kozmálovce (or the Váh canal at Bohunice) is a designated salmonid or cyprinid water, so those values are not in the limit columns. The same national rule applies to Bohunice.

Name: Krško nuclear power plant
compliance_point: point of complete mixing of Sava and NEK effluent, in the tailwater of HPP Brežice (D96/TM e=545686.070, n=84534.008); dT measured against Sava temperature at the NEK intake
source: Slovenian Ministry of Environment and Spatial Planning, environmental consent (okoljevarstveno soglasje) for NEK lifetime extension 40 to 60 years, 13 Jan 2023
legal_ref: Okoljevarstveno soglasje št. 35428-4/2021-2550-96 (13.1.2023), section II conditions 10, 11, 12, 13, 16
notes: Quote cond. 11: "dnevna povprečna temperatura reke Save v točki popolnega premešanja ne presega 28°C" and the Sava must not warm by more than 3 °C above natural temperature. Cond. 10: daily mean heat-emission share at the mixing point must be <=1. Cond. 12-13: use the cooling towers, and cut output if that is not enough. Derogation (cond. 16): from 10-01 to 04-30, if a higher energy-supply risk level is declared, the daily mean dT may be 3.5 K; the 28 °C cap still applies. No summer derogation. Outfall 43 °C is stated in the consent's reasoning as coming from the plant's environmental permit (okoljevarstveno dovoljenje), i.e. secondary for that value. Same consent: cooling towers in practice run when Sava flow is below about 100 m3/s. The NEK press release of Aug 2026 (https://www.nek.si/en/news/news/nek-to-reduce-reactor-power-tonight-to-ensure-full-compliance-with-environmental-limits) confirms 28 °C / 3 °C daily average and a cut to 80% to comply; no trigger temperature is given.

Name: Almaraz nuclear power plant
compliance_point: Water released from Arrocampo cooling reservoir (auxiliary spillway of Arrocampo dam) into Torrejón-Tajo reservoir. No limit found for water inside Arrocampo itself.
source: BOE Resolución 25-01-2008 (Secretaría General para la Prevención de la Contaminación y el Cambio Climático) on the Almaraz concession modification + CNAT operator web page
legal_ref: RDPH (RD 849/1986) Anexo IV D: discharge into lakes/reservoirs must not exceed 30 °C; BOE-A-2008-4459
notes: BOE quote: 'agua vertida al embalse de Torrejón-Tajo sea siempre inferior a los 30 grados'. The 30 °C cap applies to the Arrocampo→Torrejón discharge (outfall of the cooling pond), not to the plant outfall into Arrocampo and not to the Tajo after mixing. 20 forced-draft TEVA cooling cells near the Arrocampo dam have run since summer 2012 to meet it. CNAT (https://www.cnat.es/almaraz-refrigeracion.php): 'asegura que la temperatura del agua descargada al embalse Torrejón - Tajo no exceda de 30 º C'. Plant director in El Español 2024-05-19: 'no se puede devolver agua al Tajo a más de 30 grados'. Ecologistas en Acción report (informe-almaraz.pdf, NGO) also claims a 3 °C intake-vs-discharge limit: 'diferencia de temperatura entre el agua captada y la emitida en 3º'. No regulator text confirming that 3 °C was found, so dT is left blank. The CHT discharge authorisation itself was not found online. No observed curtailment trigger found.

Name: Ascó nuclear power plant
averaging: any time ('en cualquier caso y circunstancias'); dT = max river temperature in the downstream dispersion section minus intake-canal temperature at >=1 m depth
compliance_point: Ebro cross-section downstream of the outfall where thermal dispersion is considered complete (point proposed by operator and approved by the authority)
source: Resolución de la Dirección General de Obras Hidráulicas 28-06-1977: Ebro water concession for cooling Ascó with discharge authorisation (conditions 13-14)
legal_ref: BOE núm. 200 de 22-08-1977 pp. 18744-18746, condiciones 13 y 14
notes: Cond. 13: 'El máximo incremento admisible para la temperatura de las aguas del río' = 3 °C. Cond. 14: 'en ningún caso' may the water exceed 'una temperatura máxima de las aguas de 30° C'. Cond. 21 lets the Ministry impose new thermal conditions if Ebro limits change. The concession was novated by a CHE resolution of 22-02-2024 (BOE-B-2024-9703), which returns water 'en las condiciones que su autorización de vertido exija'. That current CHE discharge authorisation was not found, so the 1977 values may be superseded. NGOs (Ecologistes en Acció 2025) cite 3 °C (Dir. 2006/44) and 25 °C 'Plan Hidrológico del Ebro' downstream of Mequinenza; 25 °C was not found in the Ebro plan normativa (RD 35/2023 Anexo XII). CHE and ANAV deny any exceedance. Per a press search snippet (not opened), ANAV says compliance uses a daily mean.

Name: Cofrentes nuclear power plant
averaging: per composite sample of each discharge batch (as above)
compliance_point: Same outfall (balsas de vertido to Júcar / Embarcaderos tail)
source: Declaración Ambiental C.N. Cofrentes año 2024, footnote (6) to the temperature VLE
legal_ref: CHJ autorización de vertido ref. 1988C-VI-00042 (revisión 2022)
notes: Summer value not stated, so tier missing. Footnote (6): 'En época estival (1 de junio hasta 30 de septiembre) se permitirá el incremento de 3 ºC'. Most likely the 28 °C outfall VLE rises to 31 °C in summer (July-Aug 2024 readings of 29.5 °C reported as compliant), but 31 is not written anywhere. Fill T_max_outfall_C = 31 and tier permit only if the CHJ authorisation confirms it.

Name: Cofrentes nuclear power plant
averaging: per composite sample of each discharge batch from the settling ponds (balsas); max 4 non-conforming samples allowed for the cooling-water stream
compliance_point: Tower blowdown discharged from the balsas de vertido through the single authorised outfall on the right bank of the Júcar, at the tail of Embarcaderos reservoir
source: Declaración Ambiental C.N. Cofrentes año 2024 (Iberdrola EMAS statement): Tablas 34-39 of VLE authorised by CHJ
legal_ref: CHJ Resolución de revisión de la autorización de vertido ref. 1988C-VI-00042 (última revisión 2022); Reglamento de vertido CN Cofrentes Rev. 4 (2022)
notes: VLE row reads 'Temperatura ... 28 (6)'. This is an outfall limit; no river dT or downstream limit found. The closed cycle uses natural-draught towers. Authorised intake is 1.1 m3/s, of which 0.75 evaporates and 0.35 returns (operator page cncofrentes.es/medio-ambiente/la-central-y-el-agua). See next row for summer.

Name: Trillo nuclear power plant
averaging: any time / any season ('en cualquier momento o estación del año'); continuous temperature recording required
compliance_point: Tajo after dispersion of the discharge (dT = river downstream vs upstream of the outfall)
source: Resolución de la Dirección General de Obras Hidráulicas 09-09-1985: Tajo water concession for Trillo I with discharge authorisation (condition 17)
notes: Cond. 17: no 'incremento de temperatura de las aguas del río Tajo' above 3 °C, and not over 30 °C 'una vez producida la dispersión del vertido'. Cond. 18 says this reach's heat-absorption capacity is used up. Trillo uses natural-draught towers, so only blowdown reaches the Tajo. A search snippet (OSTI/ETDE record, not opened) says the CHT later revised the discharge authorisation (ref. CHT-ATT-000045), so values may be superseded; that revision was not found. Similar CHT practice elsewhere: José Cabrera (BOE-A-1996-5057) had 30 °C max and 3 °C dT on the Tajo.

Name: Beznau nuclear power plant
averaging: 25 °C limit: real-time calculated temperature, not a mean (Echtzeit-Temperatur). Shutdown test: calculated daily maximum on 3 consecutive days
compliance_point: Calculated Aare temperature after substantial mixing, below the confluence of the residual-flow reach and the HKB headrace canal ('Referenzpunkt nach HKB')
source: BFE Zwischenverfügung (interim order) to Axpo, 4 Jul 2019, which quotes the Federal Council cooling-water discharge permit of 15 Dec 1997
legal_ref: BFE Zwischenverfügung 04.07.2019 Dispositiv Ziff. 3 (vorsorgliche Massnahmen I-II); Bundesrat Einleitungsbewilligung 15.12.1997 Auflagen 3.5-3.6; GSchV SR 814.201 Anh. 2 Ziff. 12 Abs. 4 and Anh. 3.3 Ziff. 21 Abs. 4
notes: Rule: cut output (down to the 50% minimum-load point) so that the calculated mixed Aare temperature does not exceed 25 °C. Quote: 'die Echtzeit-Temperatur massgebend und nicht ein Temperaturmittelwert'. Day 1 = first exceedance of 25 °C even at 50% load. On day 3, if the daily maximum will have exceeded 25 °C on three consecutive days and the MeteoSwiss forecast shows at least 2 more days above 25 °C, both units must shut down by 15:00. Exceptions are allowed if reactor safety, supply security or grid stability are at risk. Otherwise stay at 50% while the daily max is above 25 °C. Restart only with BFE approval and a forecast below 25 °C. Operator must notify BFE when intake water reaches 24 °C and 24.5 °C. dT 3 °C: 1997 permit Auflage 3.6 ('3°C-Wert für die Aufwärmung') and GSchV. Outfall 32 °C: 1997 permit Auflage 3.5 ('Begrenzung der Einleitungstemperatur auf max. 32°C'), with power reduction between 30 and 32 °C. The 2019 order considers this clause inconsistent with the GSchV (30 °C, or 33 °C if the intake river is above 20 °C) and intends a provisional rule to replace it, but the operative part does not set a new outfall value. Axpo's 2023 request to raise it to 33 °C suggests 32 °C is still in use. The order is still in force pending a new permit; Axpo's application to relax it is pending. Derogation: GSchV Anh. 3.3 Ziff. 21 Abs. 4 lit. b lets the authority allow existing nuclear plants to discharge above 25 °C. No numeric cap. In Jul 2022 BFE let Beznau keep running above the criterion for winter supply security (SRF 25 Jul 2022). Observed triggers: 29 Jun 2025, Aare reached 25 °C after full mixing, output cut to about 50% (Axpo release 30 Jun 2025). Both units shut down by 2 Jul 2025 (SRF 3 Jul 2025), and again in late Jun 2026 after 25 °C (news reports).

Name: Goesgen nuclear power plant
averaging: Not specified (ordinance: after substantial mixing; numeric requirements apply at every flow)
compliance_point: After substantial mixing (nach weitgehender Durchmischung)
source: Swiss Water Protection Ordinance (GSchV), consolidated text as of 1 Dec 2025
legal_ref: GSchV SR 814.201 Anh. 2 Ziff. 12 Abs. 4 (warming at most 3 °C, 1.5 °C in trout zone; river at most 25 °C); Anh. 3.3 Ziff. 22 Abs. 1 lit. a (cooling-tower blowdown at most 30 °C)
notes: Plant-specific permit: UVEK cooling-water permits of 20 Sep 2018, now part of the operating licence of 29 Sep 1978. I could not find the permit text. Secondary confirmation of the outfall cap from Solothurn government decision RRB 2019/61 (https://rrb.so.ch/beschlussnummer/2019_61/download/90cb828268fe4a78bf5e1b5e235b9a78). Quote: 'Die Temperatur des eingeleiteten Wassers darf höchstens 30 °C erreichen'. The same decision says the return water is warmed by at most 6.5 °C and raises the Aare by at most 0.07 °C after mixing at extreme low flow. GSchV quote: 'Wassertemperatur 25 °C nicht übersteigen ... nach weitgehender Durchmischung'. Natural-draught tower; withdrawal averages 2.2 m3/s, max 4 m3/s. The 3 °C value assumes this reach is not trout zone (otherwise 1.5 °C); I did not check this. No river-temperature curtailment of Gösgen found.

Name: Leibstadt nuclear power plant
compliance_point: Rhine after complete mixing (nach vollständiger Durchmischung); outfall limit at the discharge into the Rhine
source: Swiss Federal Council decision of 3 Dec 2004 granting Kernkraftwerk Leibstadt AG the permit to withdraw and discharge cooling water (Rhine)
legal_ref: Bundesrat Verfügung 03.12.2004, Dispositiv Ziff. 3.2 (based on GSchV Anh. 3.2 and 3.3)
notes: Quotes: 'Die Aufwärmung des Rheins darf höchstens 3 oC betragen'; 'Temperatur des Rheins nach vollständiger Durchmischung 25 oC nicht übersteigen'. 30 °C applies to the mixed discharge (once-through auxiliary cooling plus tower blowdown plus laundry effluent). Leibstadt must notify BFE and BUWAL immediately if the Rhine at the intake exceeds 24.5 °C. Main heat goes through the natural-draught tower; discharge 1.37 to 3.33 m3/s, warmed 3 to 4 °C. Bilateral: the German side (Regierungspräsidium Freiburg) had no objection if existing conditions were kept, and the decision was copied to German federal and Baden-Württemberg ministries. No numeric German-Swiss treaty or heat-load limit found. A 1972 Rhine ministers' declaration on closed cooling was seen only in search snippets, not checked. The permit has no nuclear-specific derogation, but GSchV Anh. 3.3 Ziff. 21 Abs. 4 lit. b (in force since 1 Jun 2018) would let the authority allow it. No observed curtailment found.

Name: Khmelnitski nuclear power plant
notes: No plant-specific environmental limit found (Espoo documents, Austrian expert statements, SNRIU stress-test report, news). The only numeric rule found is USSR SanPiN 4630-88 Annex 1 (summer rise <=3 °C vs the 10-year mean of the hottest month; https://dnaop.com/html/57512_2.html), with control section from CMU Resolution 465/1999 §8; its status in Ukraine is unconfirmed and one Ukrainian source calls it repealed, so it is not used. Design limit (not regulatory): cooled pond water 'admissible boundary temperature' 33.0 °C, which limits the 4-unit plant to about 3240 MW (Energoatom 2017, https://cdn.kormany.hu//uploads/sheets//7/7d/7d4/7d4c8757045b538438eac56b8d0abeb.pdf).

Name: Rivne nuclear power plant
notes: No plant-specific limit found (Energoatom/OVD reports, special water-use permit searched). SanPiN 4630-88 (summer rise <=3 °C) found but status in Ukraine unconfirmed, possibly repealed, so not used. Plant uses cooling towers and spray ponds with water from the Styr.

Name: South Ukraine nuclear power plant
notes: No plant-specific limit found. SanPiN 4630-88 (summer rise <=3 °C) found but status in Ukraine unconfirmed, possibly repealed, so not used. Tashlyk reservoir is a technological cooling pond; Energoatom says upgrades aim to 'remove restrictions' from insufficient Tashlyk cooling capacity (WNN).

Name: Zaporizhzhia nuclear power plant
notes: No plant-specific limit found. SanPiN 4630-88 (summer rise <=3 °C) found but status in Ukraine unconfirmed, possibly repealed, so not used. Plant shut down since Sep 2022; Kakhovka reservoir destroyed Jun 2023; cooling pond is the only heat sink. SNRIU 2011 stress-test report gives only safety design values (spray-pond service water +5 to +33 °C).
